Sandbox_Talky_MaxZombiesPerAction_toolti: Zombies created by one spawn or horde step, at most.
Sandbox_Talky_MaxZombiesPerJob_tooltip: Zombies created by all the steps of one job together, at most.
Sandbox_Talky_MaxZombiesPer10Min: Max zombies per player per 10 minutes
Sandbox_Talky_MaxZombiesPer10Min_tooltip: Zombies created by the jobs of one streamer over the last 10 minutes, at most.
Sandbox_Talky_MaxZombiesPer10MinServer_t: Zombies created by Talky for every streamer together over the last 10 minutes, at most.
Sandbox_Talky_MaxSpawnDistance_tooltip: Talky zombies appear at most this far from the streamer.
Sandbox_Talky_MaxStepsPerJob_tooltip: Steps beyond this number are dropped (the server console says how many).
Sandbox_Talky_MaxQueuedJobs_tooltip: Jobs waiting for a free slot. Beyond that, the next jobs stay in the bridge's inbox and are read again a second later.
Sandbox_Talky_MaxActiveJobs: Max jobs running at the same time per player
Sandbox_Talky_MaxActiveJobs_tooltip: A job holds its slot during its wait steps too.
Sandbox_Talky_MaxJobsPerMinute: Max jobs per minute per player
Sandbox_Talky_MaxJobsPerMinute_tooltip: Extra jobs stay in the bridge's inbox until the minute is over, or until their time to live ends.
Sandbox_Talky_AllowZombies_tooltip: Allows the spawn_zombie and horde actions.
Sandbox_Talky_AllowItems_tooltip: Allows the give_item action (at most 100 items per action).
Sandbox_Talky_MaxItemsPer10Min: Max items per player per 10 minutes
Sandbox_Talky_MaxItemsPer10Min_tooltip: Items given by the jobs of one streamer over the last 10 minutes, at most.
Sandbox_Talky_ItemDenylist_tooltip: Full item types Talky may not give, separated by commas (for example Base.Katana, Base.Shotgun).
Sandbox_Talky_AllowVehicles_tooltip: Allows the vehicle action (outdoors, on the ground floor only).
Sandbox_Talky_MaxVehiclesPer10Min: Max vehicles per player per 10 minutes
Sandbox_Talky_MaxVehiclesPer10Min_toolti: Vehicles created by the jobs of one streamer over the last 10 minutes, at most. Each vehicle stays in the save.
Sandbox_Talky_AllowXp_tooltip: Allows the xp action (at most 1000 XP per action).
Sandbox_Talky_MaxXpPer10Min: Max XP per player per 10 minutes
Sandbox_Talky_MaxXpPer10Min_tooltip: XP given by the jobs of one streamer over the last 10 minutes, at most.
Sandbox_Talky_AllowPlayerEffects_tooltip: Allows the heal and stat actions, on the streamer's own character.
Sandbox_Talky_AllowWeather_tooltip: Allows the weather and thunder actions. The weather is the same for every player (at most 12 game hours per action).
Sandbox_Talky_WeatherCooldownMinutes_too: Minimum time between two weather changes, for the whole server.
Sandbox_Talky_ThunderCooldownSeconds_too: Minimum time between two thunder actions, for the whole server.
Sandbox_Talky_AllowTime_tooltip: Allows the time action. The time of day is the same for every player.
Sandbox_Talky_TimeCooldownMinutes_toolti: Minimum time between two changes of the time of day, for the whole server.
Sandbox_Talky_AllowFire_tooltip: Allows the fire action and zombies on fire. Fire spreads and can reach the bases of other players.
Sandbox_Talky_AllowHelicopter_tooltip: Allows the helicopter action. On a server the helicopter goes to a random player, not to the streamer.
Sandbox_Talky_HelicopterAnyTarget_toolti: Off: the helicopter action only runs while one player is online, so it cannot fall on someone else.
Sandbox_Talky_HelicopterCooldownMinutes_: Minimum time between two helicopters, for the whole server.
Sandbox_Talky_AllowSounds_tooltip: Allows the noise and sound actions.
Sandbox_Talky_MaxNoiseRadius_tooltip: A noise attracts every zombie within this radius of the streamer.
Sandbox_Talky_ProtectRadius_tooltip: No Talky zombie, fire or vehicle appears this close to another online player, nor in a safehouse the streamer may not enter. 0 = no distance check.
Sandbox_Talky_BannerAudience_tooltip: Who sees the on-screen banners of a streamer's jobs.
Sandbox_Talky_BannerAudience_option2: Every player, with the streamer's name
Sandbox_Talky_AllowCustomActions_tooltip: Allows the actions other mods add with Talky_Actions.register and mark as network-safe.
